results.title: Trevor Lies
results.overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

results.title: Closing Time
results.overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

results.title: Party on!
results.overview: After being thrown out of a club because of a fight, Niko, Sascha, Elina, and Andrej make their way through Vienna to find another place to party, but as the night goes on, more and more problems arise between them.

results.title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
results.overview: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

results.title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
results.original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
results.overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

results.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
results.original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話
results.overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

results.title: You, Like a Star
results.overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

results.title: Waves Turn
results.overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

results.title: Laika Goes Home
results.overview: Captain Talia Valentine is an ambitious young astronaut, whose return to Earth is interrupted when she crash-lands on a lonely asteroid. Laika is a little stray dog from the streets of Moscow, who has been stranded on that same asteroid for a very long time...  Talia is in a one-track mind about finding her way off of this forsaken rock. Laika just seems thrilled to have someone to play with her. But when fixes fail, and unexpected communications bridge the expanse between Talia and the Earth, she realises that Laika may be the key to finding her way home - wherever that ends up being.

results.title: Escape Room 2
results.overview: Beneath Montjuïc, four people are trapped in an old tunnel, and a countdown of sixty minutes begins. Each second that passes tests what they will risk to get out, and whom they will trust along the way.

results.title: Simon Small
results.overview: Bertil lives with his parents. One day, all of a sudden, a little thumb size boy appears under his bed! His name is Simon Small. The 2 boys bond right away and Nils shows Bertil a fascinating magical world right inside his bedroom walls. Neither of them will ever be lonely again.

results.title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
results.original_title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
results.overview: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

results.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
results.overview: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

results.title: Mother Knows Best
results.overview: In the wake of a tragic accident, a mother's unwavering care pushes the limits of morality as she does whatever it takes to protect her son.

results.title: Almost There
results.overview: An aspiring musician nearing thirty grapples with the end of her carefree twenties as life demands she embrace maturity and responsibility.

results.title: Touching the Sky
results.overview: Touching the Sky takes the viewer on a voyage of human powered flight like never before  - following wingsuit base jumpers in the European Alps, and a paragliding team across the Himalayas in Pakistan.

results.title: Faraway Home
results.overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

results.title: A Hair's Breadth
results.overview: Beck’s new moustache makes waves when it slows him down in the pool shortly before a big race. As his coach grows more aggressive in his attempts to make him shave, Beck must choose between his moustache and freedom, or his coach and treading water.
